BEGIN READ ONLY;
WITH targets AS (
 SELECT c.oid,n.nspname,c.relname,c.relkind,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity,c.reloptions
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 WHERE ((n.nspname='warehouse' AND c.relname IN ('products','locations','storage_areas','lots','inventory_units','inventory_position_v1','movements','bi_movements_v1','receipts','quality_inspections','bi_quality_v1','inventory_holds','allocations','department_stock_requests','fulfillment_orders','customer_return_cases','vendor_returns','cycle_counts','bi_cycle_counts_v1','kit_definitions','rekit_work_orders','suppliers','purchase_orders')) OR (n.nspname='procurement' AND c.relname IN ('requests','approval_steps','purchase_order_amendment_steps','sourcing_events','route_decisions','sourcing_responses','purchase_orders','purchase_order_lines','purchase_order_amendments','receipts','v_purchase_order_receipt_status','payment_readiness_packs','payment_readiness_staleness_events','acceptance_packs'))) AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m')
)
SELECT clock_timestamp() AS reviewed_at, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'relation', t.nspname||'.'||t.relname, 'kind', t.relkind,
 'rls_enabled',t.relrowsecurity,'rls_forced',t.relforcerowsecurity,
 'view_options',coalesce(to_jsonb(t.reloptions),'[]'::jsonb),
 'view_definition',CASE WHEN t.relkind IN ('v','m') THEN pg_catalog.pg_get_viewdef(t.oid,true) ELSE NULL END,
 'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'postgres_type',pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'nullable',NOT a.attnotnull) ORDER BY a.attnum)
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=t.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped),
 'constraints',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',con.conname,'kind',con.contype,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid,true)) ORDER BY con.conname)
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint con WHERE con.conrelid=t.oid AND con.contype IN ('p','u','f','c')),'[]'::jsonb)
) ORDER BY t.nspname,t.relname) AS relations FROM targets t;
ROLLBACK;

relations.view_definition:
SELECT purchase_order_id,
    ordered_quantity,
    accepted_quantity,
    rejected_or_quarantined_quantity,
    outstanding_quantity,
    latest_warehouse_receipt_reference,
    qc_status,
    last_received_at,
    accepted_lines
   FROM private.procurement_po_receipt_status() procurement_po_receipt_status(purchase_order_id, ordered_quantity, accepted_quantity, rejected_or_quarantined_quantity, outstanding_quantity, latest_warehouse_receipt_reference, qc_status, last_received_at, accepted_lines);

SELECT (count_record.id || '|'::text) || ((line.ordinality - 1)::text) AS id,
    count_record.id AS cycle_count_id,
    count_record.location_id,
    count_record.bin_id,
    count_record.status,
    count_record.submitted_at,
    line.value ->> 'productId'::text AS product_id,
    (line.value ->> 'expected'::text)::integer AS expected,
    (line.value ->> 'counted'::text)::integer AS counted,
    ((line.value ->> 'counted'::text)::integer) - ((line.value ->> 'expected'::text)::integer) AS variance
   FROM warehouse.cycle_counts count_record
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(count_record.lines) WITH ORDINALITY line(value, ordinality)
  WHERE count_record.status <> 'draft'::text;

SELECT movement.id,
    movement.created_at,
    movement.type,
    movement.product_id,
    product.sku,
    movement.quantity,
    movement.from_location_id,
    movement.to_location_id,
    movement.from_bin_id,
    movement.to_bin_id,
    movement.lot_id,
    movement.serial_number,
    movement.event_id,
    movement.reason,
    movement.reference
   FROM warehouse.movements movement
     JOIN warehouse.products product ON product.id = movement.product_id;

SELECT inspection.id,
    inspection.inspected_at AS created_at,
    inspection.source_type,
    inspection.source_id,
    inspection.product_id,
    product.sku,
    inspection.location_id,
    inspection.bin_id,
    inspection.lot_id,
    inspection.serial_number,
    inspection.quantity,
    inspection.disposition,
    inspection.reason,
        CASE
            WHEN hold.status = 'active'::text THEN hold.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END AS active_hold_quantity
   FROM warehouse.quality_inspections inspection
     JOIN warehouse.products product ON product.id = inspection.product_id
     LEFT JOIN warehouse.inventory_holds hold ON hold.inspection_id = inspection.id;

relations.view_definition:
WITH on_hand AS (
         SELECT stock_levels.product_id,
            stock_levels.location_id,
            stock_levels.bin_id,
            sum(stock_levels.quantity) AS on_hand
           FROM warehouse.stock_levels
          GROUP BY stock_levels.product_id, stock_levels.location_id, stock_levels.bin_id
        UNION ALL
         SELECT inventory_units.product_id,
            inventory_units.location_id,
            inventory_units.bin_id,
            count(*) AS on_hand
           FROM warehouse.inventory_units
          WHERE inventory_units.status = ANY (ARRAY['in_stock'::text, 'returned'::text])
          GROUP BY inventory_units.product_id, inventory_units.location_id, inventory_units.bin_id
        ), positions AS (
         SELECT on_hand.product_id,
            on_hand.location_id,
            on_hand.bin_id,
            sum(on_hand.on_hand)::bigint AS on_hand
           FROM on_hand
          GROUP BY on_hand.product_id, on_hand.location_id, on_hand.bin_id
        ), ranked AS (
         SELECT positions.product_id,
            positions.location_id,
            positions.bin_id,
            positions.on_hand,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY positions.product_id ORDER BY positions.location_id, positions.bin_id NULLS FIRST) AS product_position
           FROM positions
        ), commitments AS (
         SELECT allocations.product_id,
            sum(allocations.quantity) AS committed
           FROM warehouse.allocations
          WHERE allocations.status = ANY (ARRAY['reserved'::text, 'allocated'::text])
          GROUP BY allocations.product_id
        ), holds AS (
         SELECT inventory_holds.product_id,
            inventory_holds.location_id,
            inventory_holds.bin_id,
            sum(inventory_holds.quantity) AS held
           FROM warehouse.inventory_holds
          WHERE inventory_holds.status = 'active'::text
          GROUP BY inventory_holds.product_id, inventory_holds.location_id, inventory_holds.bin_id
        ), unavailable AS (
         SELECT inventory_units.product_id,
            inventory_units.location_id,
            inventory_units.bin_id,
            count(*) AS unavailable
           FROM warehouse.inventory_units
          WHERE inventory_units.status = 'returned'::text
          GROUP BY inventory_units.product_id, inventory_units.location_id, inventory_units.bin_id
        )
 SELECT (((ranked.product_id || '|'::text) || ranked.location_id) || '|'::text) || COALESCE(ranked.bin_id, ''::text) AS id,
    ranked.product_id,
    ranked.location_id,
    ranked.bin_id,
    ranked.on_hand,
        CASE
            WHEN ranked.product_position = 1 THEN COALESCE(commitments.committed, 0::bigint)
            ELSE 0::bigint
        END AS committed,
    COALESCE(holds.held, 0::bigint) AS held,
    COALESCE(unavailable.unavailable, 0::bigint) AS unavailable,
    GREATEST(ranked.on_hand -
        CASE
            WHEN ranked.product_position = 1 THEN COALESCE(commitments.committed, 0::bigint)
            ELSE 0::bigint
        END - COALESCE(holds.held, 0::bigint) - COALESCE(unavailable.unavailable, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) AS available,
    '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone AS created_at
   FROM ranked
     LEFT JOIN commitments USING (product_id)
     LEFT JOIN holds ON holds.product_id = ranked.product_id AND holds.location_id = ranked.location_id AND NOT holds.bin_id IS DISTINCT FROM ranked.bin_id
     LEFT JOIN unavailable ON unavailable.product_id = ranked.product_id AND unavailable.location_id = ranked.location_id AND NOT unavailable.bin_id IS DISTINCT FROM ranked.bin_id;
